newsitem.title: USA: First Palm restates Q4 results amid loss provision.
newsitem.headline: First Palm restates Q4 results amid loss provision.

text.p: First Palm Beach Bancorp Inc said it added a loan loss provision of $4 million to its fourth-quarter financial results for losses related to indirect automobile lending.
The additional provision brings its total for loan losses related to indirect automobile lending to $9 million as of September 30, the company said.

As a result, the company restated its fourth-quarter loss to $7.3 million, or $1.44 a share, from a loss of $4.9 million, or $0.97 a share. The company said its restated net income is now 0.11 a share, instead of $0.58 a share.
